## Testing Mode: RED

Write behavioral tests for merge-story-branch.sh BEFORE implementation exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

- WHEN story branch has commits: THEN merge commit on session branch has `DSO-Story-Merge: <story-id>` trailer (key is DSO-Story-Merge:, NOT DSO-Story: — distinct from apply-attribution-trailers.sh)
- Merge commit message produced by: `printf 'Merge %s\n\nDSO-Story-Merge: %s' "$STORY_BRANCH" "$STORY_ID"`
- WHEN story branch does not exist: THEN exits non-zero with error on stderr
- No conflict-queue precondition test (conflict queue is orchestrator in-memory state, not testable at shell level)

## Files to create
- tests/scripts/test-merge-story-branch.sh (executable, registered in .test-index)

## Standards
Follow plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md. Use git scratch repo in /tmp; assert trailer present in `git log --format=%B -1 HEAD`.
